en: I have no more knowledge to bestow upon you. Go through the archway and down the ramp to the southeast, and talk to Doctor Herbert Halsey. He is a Forsaken who can teach you more advanced techniques.

Before my death, I was a librarian; I had nothing to do with wars and plagues. I never asked to become this. On the other hand, now that my mind is my own again, I'm not about to surrender without a fight.
Now where did I put the Venture Company formulations?
Come forth, ye Dreamers - and claim your vengeance!
Off to Orgrimmar with you, $n. Say hi to Thrall for me!
At last... Freed from his cursed grasp!
Greetings, $n. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.
Anyone suspicious is to be taken down quickly. Get to your posts as quickly as possible!
Here for training eh? Just began my training meself, but I would be glad ta teach ye what I can.
Yes, please summon it back!
Here for the rod? Or, maybe you're simply stocking up on runes?$B$BWait a minute! Are you just trying to offload a whole bunch of junk on me?! Curse my never-ending compulsion to buy, buy, buy!
Together, the two parts shall become one, once again.

The time has come for Horde and Alliance to look towards the north and the invasion of the Scourge. In recent days, territories across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms have come under attack. Will you take up arms to save your land from destruction at their hands?

This is some specialized equipment! Don't be handling it carelessly, and of course don't try and operate the thing if you've had too much of that volatile rum I hear you like so much...$B$BSpeaking of which... you don't happen to have any of that nasty stuff, do you?

Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!$B$BThelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

The Scourge brought only small forces to bear against each of Azeroth's capital cities, while their main forces periodically attack the following lands:$B$BAzshara, the Blasted Lands, the Burning Steppes, the Tanaris Desert, the Eastern Plaguelands and Winterspring.
The masquerade is over, Lady Prestor. Or should I call you by your true name... Onyxia...
Kibler is being investigated by G.E.T.A.
How fortuitous. Usually, I must leave my lair in order to feed.
Gettin' a bit nippy out here. Think I will go warm myself by the fire and grab a pint or twelve.
If it weren't for that cursed, gnomish luck, they'd never win a race!
Constant bickering will get us nowhere.  We need to take action.
Well done! Your understanding of potions is coming along nicely.
Continue please, this story is intriguing.
Please wait while I attempt to bind the shards together so that they will be whole once again.
You're into leather, eh?  Sounds like you should talk to Simon Tanner over in Old Town.  He runs a shop there called the Protective Hide.
Okay, okay! Enough fighting. No one else needs to get hurt.
No!  You cannot be stronger than the Foulweald!  No!!
The Iceblood Tower protects the Iceblood Garrison from the southeast.$B$BIt is controlled by the Horde.

In your rush to glory, you assumed that the pace of the game revolved around your actions. Can you even fathom how preposterous that sounds to a being like me? A being that if so inclined could cause your own insignificant thoughts to crush the peanut sized mass of grey matter floating within your skull.
It's time for the main event!  Skarr the Unbreakable is in the Maul!

Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.
I would never have expected to find something in such perfect condition.
More agents of the Syndicate I'll wager! You'll never take back Alterac... or Southshore!
The Thunder Bluff Bank can be found on the lower rise.
Come for the beer, stay for the atmosphere!
An orc - a true orc warrior - wishes for one thing: To die in the glory of battle against a hated enemy.
$n, my wounds are grave.  Forgive my slow pace but my injuries won't allow me to walk any faster.

Ah, nothing better than a priest to cure what ails ye.  Of course a nice tall pint cures a lot of what ails ye too, but I don't think Braenna Flintcrag teaches brewing.  I guess ye'll have to settle for some priest training over in the Hall of Mysteries instead.
Fall!
You would doom us all...

$G Sir : Ma'am;, yes $g sir : ma'am;! Private Porter reporting for duty and ready to assist you with your medium leather collection needs. The Ahn'Qiraj War is coming and we need to be as prepared as we can be.$B$BAs you can see we have collected exactly $2063w pieces of medium leather, and I have been tasked with gathering a total of $2064w.
The Nightmare is finally over!  Darrowshire, forgive me!
Now, it is time to bring her reign to an end, Marcus. Stand down, friend.
Ahh... welcome to my parlor.
I present to you the Libram of Constitution.
